annotations.title: App Store listing and featuring drafts

description: Use this when the user asks about proposed App Store listing edits, featuring nominations, in-app events or custom product pages. App Store listing and featuring drafts for one app, as Apptiller proposed them. listing_edits: open proposals for the promotional text, subtitle, keyword field or description, and those applied or undone in the last 90 days, each with its field, locale, the text live now (as the daily App Store Connect read last saw it), the text it was drafted from, the proposed text, why, its status (proposed, failed, applied, undone), any error, the version it rides on, and whether it was pasted by hand. store_drafts: featuring nominations, in-app events and custom product pages with their drafted text and dates, status (proposed, created in App Store Connect, submitted to Apple, failed) and any error; with the signs of being featured (jumps in App Store browse impressions) and readiness numbers. Read-only: it drafts, applies, creates, submits or rejects nothing.
name: app_store_drafts
title: App Store listing and featuring drafts
